fields.label: Setup Help
fields.options:
Azure app registration
Entra portal → App registrations → New registration → add a Web redirect URI matching the one below → create a client secret → grant the permissions listed under Delegated Scopes and give admin consent. Then copy the client and tenant IDs here.

fields.label: Capabilities
fields.description: Pick what you want. The Azure permissions follow from what you tick.

fields.label: Outlook calendar
fields.description: Two-way Event sync, including the Teams meeting tickbox on an Event.

fields.label: Standalone Teams meetings
fields.description: Standalone meetings, and finding a meeting from its join link. Transcripts need this.

fields.label: Meeting transcripts and recordings
fields.description: Read transcripts and recordings of past meetings. Usually needs admin consent.

fields.label: Outlook mail
fields.description: Sets up and checks the connection. Frappe's Email Account still sends the mail.

fields.label: Mail Sign-in Method
fields.description: Delegated: a person signs in. Application: no sign-in, for shared mailboxes.

fields.label: Sign in with Microsoft
fields.description: Adds a Microsoft button to the login page.

fields.label: SharePoint document storage
fields.description: Store attachments of chosen DocTypes in SharePoint / Teams instead of on this server. Uses an application permission (Sites.Selected), not anyone's sign-in.

fields.label: Capabilities Help
fields.options: Use Set Up to create what each capability needs. Nothing existing is ever modified.

fields.label: Client Secret Value
fields.description: The Value column in Azure, not the Secret ID next to it.

fields.label: Redirect URI
fields.description: Register this exact URI in Azure. Blank uses the site default.

fields.label: Document Storage Help
fields.options: Each record of a mapped DocType gets its own folder, created on first use. New attachments are moved there in the background and open through Frappe for anyone allowed to read the record; files people add to the folder in Teams or SharePoint show in the record's Files in Microsoft 365 panel. The Azure app needs the Sites.Selected application permission with admin consent, plus write access granted on each site — Set Up and Run Diagnostics walk through it.

fields.label: Keep a local copy after upload
fields.description: Off frees this server's disk, which is the point for most sites. On keeps both, e.g. while trialling.

fields.label: Also copy linked files into SharePoint
fields.description: Attachments that are only a web link (e.g. a document published on a public website) are downloaded once and archived in the record's folder. The link itself is kept.

fields.label: Remove from SharePoint when the attachment is deleted
fields.description: Off by default: deleting an attachment in Frappe leaves the SharePoint copy alone. On sends it to the site's recycle bin, where it can be restored.

fields.label: Delegated Scopes
fields.description: Grant exactly these in Azure. You should not need to edit anything here.

fields.label: Override Delegated Scopes
fields.description: Advanced. Leave empty so scopes follow the capabilities above.

fields.label: Scopes Last Authorised
fields.description: What the last sign-in asked for. A token only carries the permissions it was issued with.
